legs.label: Trend pullback (RSI)
legs.rules: When price is above EMA200, buy when RSI(2) drops below 25 (mirror for shorts below the EMA); exit when RSI(2) rises above 70 or after 48 bars; stop 3× ATR.

legs.label: Trend pullback (RSI)
legs.rules: When price is above EMA50, buy when RSI(2) drops below 25 (mirror for shorts below the EMA); exit when RSI(2) rises above 50 or after 12 bars; stop 3× ATR.

legs.label: Bollinger mean reversion
legs.rules: Buy a close below the lower Bollinger band (20, 2σ), sell a close above the upper band; take profit at the middle band; stop 3× ATR; max 36 bars.

legs.label: Donchian breakout
legs.rules: Buy a close above the 55-bar high (sell a close below the 55-bar low); exit on a close beyond the 20-bar opposite channel; stop 2× ATR.

legs.label: Donchian breakout
legs.rules: Buy a close above the 20-bar high (sell a close below the 20-bar low); exit on a close beyond the 10-bar opposite channel; stop 3× ATR.

legs.label: Donchian breakout
legs.rules: Buy a close above the 55-bar high (sell a close below the 55-bar low); exit on a close beyond the 20-bar opposite channel; stop 3× ATR.

legs.label: Donchian breakout
legs.rules: Buy a close above the 20-bar high (sell a close below the 20-bar low); exit on a close beyond the 10-bar opposite channel; stop 3× ATR.
